name: IEA Bioenergy TCP
notes: IEA Technology Collaboration Programme (est. 1978) whose Tasks cover biomass combustion (32), gasification (33), thermochemical liquefaction (34), waste valorisation (36), biogas (37), biofuels (39), biorefining (42) and flexible bioenergy (44); publishes open technical reports, country reports and factsheets. Relevant to the biomass WTE, pyrolysis/HTL and BECCS cards. Evidence: ieabioenergy.com read 2026-10-29.
